newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on short covering.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply higher on Tuesday, led by July on commission house short covering, pit sources said.
"This was just near-month liquidation," a trader said. "Rosenthal Collins was a strong buyer."
The July/September spread closed 10-1/2 cents per cwt firmer at $1.40-1/2, premium July, leading some to predict more gains were in store.
"The July/Sept closed above $1.40 and that's kind of pointing the way up," one floor source said.
Cash markets were said to be quiet in thin volume.
Rice ended 16-1/2 to two cents per cwt higher with July up 16-1/2 at $11.60-1/2.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 250 lots, against Friday's actual volume of 30 lots.
